messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the containment call — capturing the post-incident action items so we don't lose them. Short list below, please react with :+1: if you own an item or say who will.
maria: Incident summary: a mis-scoped service account token was used to access a small set of internal APIs. We contained by revoking tokens and blocking the account. Root cause: overly broad role assigned during recent infra automation change. No data exfil observed, but we need to harden controls.
ben: Thanks. I can take the KMS/key rotation piece. Question: do we rotate the key material or create a new key+alias swap? What's our target SLA for the swap? 24h? 72h?
carla: Recommend create a new CMK, update aliases, then re-encrypt any long-term data as async. Alias swap is lower risk. Target 48h for alias swap and 7 days for full re-encryption backlog.
maria: Sounds good. Ben — please coordinate with infra and app owners for any in-flight jobs that use the key. Add a short maintenance window if needed.
devsec-bot: Created ticket SE-4192: "KMS alias rotation + re-encryption plan" and added to eng-security backlog. (link: https://redwood.example/tickets/SE-4192)
ben: Taking SE-4192. I'll draft the runbook. Preliminary CLI snippets for AWS KMS alias swap (for reference):

```
# create new key
aws kms create-key --description "rotated key for service-x"
# point alias to new key
aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/service-x --target-key-id 1234abcd-... 
# verify
aws kms list-aliases | grep service-x
```

ben: Also will run CloudTrail query to list Decrypt/Encrypt events in the incident window and attach to the ticket.
carla: For audit logs we should extend retention for CloudTrail -> S3 archive for an extra 90 days and ensure logs are immutable. I'll file a config change. SE-4193.
dave: RBAC follow-ups: remove 'infra_admin' from the automation service account, replace with a scoped role 'svc_infra_readwrite' limited to only the resources it needs. Also add a periodic review for SA roles (every 30 days).
maria: Assign RBAC changes to @frank to implement the role and apply to the service account. Frank, can you own the change and coordinate with Carla for testing?
frank: I can own RBAC. Will make a small change set, deploy to staging, and run a canary job. Plan to have PR today, deploy tomorrow morning.
emily: From product/security/comms: we'll need a short customer/internal blurb if any partners could have seen the error. I can draft wording after we have final containment notes. Also recommend a tabletop in 2 weeks to exercise the new flow.
maria: Tabletop: propose 2026-04-07 10:00 PT. Emily, can you organize invites + scenario doc? Add scenario: compromised SA -> detection -> kill token -> rotate KMS.
emily: Yes, putting it on the calendar and will post the scenario doc to the incident channel.
devsec-bot: Created meeting incident-retrospective event and linked SE-4192, SE-4193, SE-4194.
ben: One more technical item — add a detection rule in our SIEM for anomalous SA token usage (sudden token creation + cross-region API calls). I'll prototype a Sigma rule and attach to SE-4195.
carla: For auditability: add an automated daily export of IAM policy diffs to the security bucket. That will help surface accidental broad grants. SE-4196.
maria: To recap owners: SE-4192 (ben) KMS rotation, SE-4193 (carla) audit retention + immutability, SE-4194 (frank) RBAC role change, SE-4195 (ben) detection rule, SE-4196 (carla) IAM diffs export, Emily tabletop + comms. Please update the tickets with ETA and mark blockers.
frank: PR is up: https://redwood.example/pr/5587 — includes role definition and least-priv policy. Requesting review from @carla and @dave.
carla: Reviewing now. Suggest adding a test that fails CI if a SA has wildcard on actions in prod.
dave: Agreed — we can add a policy check step in the infra CI to catch wildcards. I'll add it to our pipeline tasks.
maria: Thanks all. small note: please add short blameless RCA summary to the ticket (root cause, why controls missed it, mitigation) before the tabletop. We'll use that as the baseline for policy updates.
ben: Ack. I'll attach CloudTrail queries and a quick runbook for alias swap.
frank: :thumbsup:
emily: I'll draft the internal comms and share for review by EOD.
maria: Closing the thread for now — will post updates to the tickets. If anything urgent pops up, ping me directly. Thanks everyone.
